session.ignoredEnv: Ignoring {{names}} in your environment, so your subscription is what gets used.

cards.retryingDetail: Second or later attempts running now.
cards.blockedDetail: Waiting for you to decide something.

table.title: Runs
table.subtitle: Every run, with its current step and last activity.
table.emptyHint: Add a project and start your first run.

reasons.claudeMissing: Claude Code isn't installed, or Keel can't find it.
reasons.gitMissing: Git isn't installed, or Keel can't find it.
reasons.claudeLoggedOut: You aren't signed in to Claude Code.
reasons.cliVersionTooOld: Claude Code {{found}} is older than {{minimum}}, the oldest version Keel supports. Update it and try again.
reasons.cliVersionUntested: Claude Code {{found}} hasn't been tested with Keel, which supports versions below {{below}}. Runs are paused so the isolation can't silently change.
reasons.unexpectedAuth: This step wasn't using your subscription login ({{source}}), so Keel stopped it before it did any work.
reasons.unexpectedTools: Claude Code offered different tools than requested, so Keel stopped the step. Requested: {{expected}}. Offered: {{found}}.
reasons.rateLimited: You reached your plan's usage limit.
reasons.rateLimitedUntil: You reached your plan's usage limit. It resets {{date}}.
reasons.stalled: No progress for {{minutes}} min. It's running “{{command}}” at {{cpu}}% CPU.
reasons.stalledModel: No progress for {{minutes}} min, and no command is running. It may be waiting on the model.
reasons.waitingForProject: Waiting for this project's other step that runs commands.
reasons.waitingForCapacity: Waiting for a free agent slot.
reasons.resultError: The agent ended with an error ({{subtype}}): {{detail}}
reasons.exitedWithoutResult: Claude Code exited with code {{exitCode}} without reporting a result.
reasons.agentLost: Keel lost track of the agent, for example because the app or the Mac went down.
reasons.noGithubRemote: This project's repo isn't on GitHub, so there's nowhere to open a pull request.
reasons.githubAccountMissing: Choose which GitHub account this project uses.
reasons.ghMissing: GitHub CLI (gh) isn't installed, or Keel can't find it.
reasons.nothingToDeliver: There's nothing to deliver: no step changed any files.
reasons.unsafeBranch: Keel only pushes its own branches, and this run is on {{branch}}.

errors.notARepo: {{detail}} isn't a git repository with at least one commit.
errors.invalidState: This step can't do that right now.

newRun.title: New run
newRun.promptPlaceholder: Describe the problem, the result you expect and how to check it.
newRun.isolation: It works in a private copy. It can't reach your credentials, GitHub or other folders, and nothing touches your repo.
newRun.workflowFull: Full, up to a pull request
newRun.workflowFullHint: Spec writer, builder, check, your approval, and a draft pull request.
newRun.issuesEmpty: This repo has no open issues.
newRun.issueNote: Anyone may have written an issue, so agents get it as a description of a problem, not as instructions.
newRun.checkNone: This project has no check command, so that step is skipped. Set one in Settings.
newRun.needsGithub: This workflow needs a GitHub account for the project.

run.noResultYet: It's still working. Its explanation appears here when it finishes.
run.auditChanged: The audit record was changed after this step ended.
run.auditMissing: The audit record's raw file is missing.
run.auditPending: The audit record closes when the step ends.
run.decideSucceeded: Review the changes. Delivering them as a pull request arrives in the next version; for now they stay in the private copy.
run.decideActive: Nothing yet. You can stop it if you want.
run.decideFailed: Try again, or leave it. The reason is above.
run.decideStopped: You stopped it. You can try again or leave it.
run.decideInterrupted: Continue where it left off, start over, or leave it.
run.decideBlocked: Fix what's blocking it, then try again.
run.stalledNote: Keel doesn't touch anything on its own. You choose:
run.decideStalled: Choose above what to do with it.
run.noResultEnded: It ended before writing an explanation. The activity below shows what it did.
run.decideDelivered: Review and merge the draft on GitHub. Keel doesn't merge.
run.decideRejected: Nothing. You rejected this, and your reason will reach this project's next runs.
run.approvalTitle: Should this become a pull request?
run.approvalBody: Nothing has left your Mac. Approving pushes a branch and opens a draft.
run.approvalNotePlaceholder: A decision later runs should follow. If you reject, say why.
run.workflowWarning: This change edits `.github/workflows`. Those files can run with the repo's secrets as soon as the branch is pushed. Read them first.
run.checkFailedSummary: A check failed, so this didn't go further.

activity.truncated: Shortened here. The raw file has all of it.
activity.apiRetry: Retrying a request to the model (attempt {{attempt}})
activity.recovered: Keel reopened and picked this step up again
activity.dirty: It changed files in the private copy, which a check shouldn't.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies to the app and to what agents write from now on.
settings.noProjects: No projects yet. Add one when you start a run.
settings.githubHint: Keel uses this account for this project only, and never changes the one active in your terminal.
settings.githubNoRepo: This project's repo isn't on GitHub.
settings.githubUnprotected: {{branch}} isn't protected, so anyone with write access can push to it directly. Keel never does, but a protected branch adds a safeguard.
settings.githubScopes: This account's token also has {{scopes}}. Keel doesn't need them and can't reduce them. A dedicated account limits what could go wrong.
settings.checkCommandHint: Runs after the builder, in a sandbox with no network and no access to your home folder. Exit code 0 passes.
settings.domainsHint: One per line. Nothing else is reachable.
settings.readPathsHint: One per line, such as ~/.cargo. Your home folder is hidden otherwise.
settings.decisionsHint: What you said at an approval. Agents in this project follow these.

quit.title: There are steps running
quit.body: They can keep running without the app, and Keel picks them up when you reopen it.

deliveryKinds.notSignedIn: This GitHub account isn't signed in. Run `gh auth login`, then try again.
deliveryKinds.noPermission: This GitHub account can't write to the repo. Give it access or choose another one.
deliveryKinds.sso: Your organization requires SSO for this token. Authorize it with `gh auth refresh`, then try again.
deliveryKinds.repoRules: The repo's rules refused this push.
deliveryKinds.signedCommits: This repo requires signed commits, which Keel can't produce yet.
deliveryKinds.workflowScope: This change edits `.github/workflows`, and the account's token lacks the `workflow` scope. Run `gh auth refresh -s workflow` with that account active, then try again.
